tools.name: get_compact_brief
tools.description: Return a token-efficient briefing of recent news articles about a topic, synthesized from the ClarityBriefs database (no live news-API call). Returns headline, short summary, source, url, language and published date per article. CROSS-LINGUAL: pass source_languages to also search foreign-language ne

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search recent news articles in the ClarityBriefs database about a topic. Returns up to 10 matches with headline, source and published date. Read-only.

tools.name: suggest_topics
tools.description: List popular public briefing topics other users follow, as ideas to track. Read-only. No arguments.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_compact_brief" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
